EvaluationSchema.description:
Wire tag of gold tasks, evaluation requests and results. Wave K1 writes `evaluation.v2`;
`evaluation.v1` (C0) documents are still read and keep their `request_hash`, because a document
is re-serialized with the tag it was read with and v1 documents never carry a v2 field. A v2
addition (a gold task or set, a harness benchmark) is refused under the v1 tag.

oneOf.description: C0. Still read; new documents are written as v2.

GoldPrompt.description: The runner-facing form of a gold task: no answer key, no supporting evidence, no reviewers.

GoldTaskClass.description: How a task is answered and scored (`LANES_V2.md` §6, T10).

oneOf.description:
Multiple choice with an "insufficient evidence" option (LitQA2 format); scored on accuracy
and on precision, so abstaining counts.
A statement to support: scored on whether the cited locator supports it (ALCE/FACT style).
A computation with an executable check (ScienceAgentBench/BixBench style).
Only through the frozen evaluator protocol; the task carries no answer of its own.

Origin.description:
Who produced a payload. `synthetic_fixture` marks hand-made contract examples; such payloads (and
anything computed from them) can never be presented as NASA results or qualify a model.
Produced-by-the-system payloads are `system` even when their *data* is synthetic (that is
`EvidenceClass::Synthetic` / `TrainedOn::Synthetic`).

description: The prompts of a dev set, as a builder's harness runner reads them (M10). Always a dev set.

set_hash.description: The `set_hash` of the dev set the prompts come from.

title: GoldPromptSet
